Head_and_Face: Head is broad and massive with a short muzzle and powerful jaws.
Ears are small, rounded, and erect with black backs and white spots.
Eyes are medium-sized, round, and golden-yellow with an intense, alert expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is large, muscular, and stocky with powerful legs and a relatively short tail.
Coat is short, dense, and golden-tawny with black spots arranged in rosette patterns.
Each rosette contains one or more small black dots inside (distinguishing from leopard).
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail is relatively short, thick, and ringed with black.

Head_and_Face: Head is broad with a short muzzle.
Ears are small, rounded, and erect.
Eyes are medium-sized, round, and amber to brown with an intense expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is large, muscular, and well-proportioned with powerful legs and a long tail with a dark tuft at the end.
Coat is short, dense, and uniform tawny with a lighter underside.
Males have a prominent shaggy mane ranging from blonde to dark brown surrounding the head and neck.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail has a dark tuft at the end.

Head_and_Face: Head is broad with a short muzzle and prominent white facial markings.
Ears are small, rounded, and erect with white spots on the back.
Eyes are medium-sized, round, and yellow-green with an intense expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is large, muscular, and well-proportioned with powerful legs and a long tail with black rings.
Coat is short, dense, and orange-tawny with black stripes running vertically along the body and a white underside.
Each tiger has a unique stripe pattern.

Head_and_Face: Head is small with a short muzzle and distinctive black tear marks running from inner eye corners to mouth.
Ears are small, rounded, and set high.
Eyes are medium-sized, round, and amber with an alert expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is lean, athletic, and well-proportioned with long legs, deep chest, and flexible spine.
Coat is short, fine, and golden-tawny with evenly distributed solid black spots (not rosettes).
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail is long, thick, and ringed with black.

Head_and_Face: Head is broad with a dished facial profile and short muzzle.
Ears are small, rounded, and set wide apart.
Eyes are small, dark, and deep-set.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is massive, heavily built, and well-muscled with a prominent shoulder hump and powerful legs.
Coat is long, dense, and coarse ranging from light blonde to dark brown.
Distinctive shoulder hump of muscle.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail is very short and hidden in fur.

Head_and_Face: Head is broad with a straight profile and longer muzzle than brown bear.
Ears are large, rounded, and set wide apart.
Eyes are small, dark, and deep-set.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is smaller than the brown bear with a straight facial profile and no shoulder hump.
Coat is short to medium-length, dense, and coarse in black, brown, cinnamon, blonde, or blue-grey.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail is very short and hidden in fur.

Head_and_Face: Head is narrow and elongated with a straight profile.
Ears are small, rounded, and set wide apart.
Eyes are small, dark, and deep-set.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is massive, elongated, and well-muscled with a long neck and large paws adapted for swimming.
Coat appears white but has transparent, hollow guard hairs over black skin.
Coat is thick, water-repellent, and provides insulation in extreme cold.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail is very short and hidden in fur.

Head_and_Face: Head is broad with a long, flexible snout and protruding lips.
Ears are large, pendulous, and set wide apart.
Eyes are small, dark, and deep-set.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is medium-sized, lean, and well-muscled with long, curved claws adapted for termite eating.
Coat is long, shaggy, and black with a distinctive white or cream V-shaped marking on the chest.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail is very short and hidden in fur.

Head_and_Face: Head is elongated with a pointed muzzle.
Ears are small, rounded, and set low.
Eyes are small, dark, and alert.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is long, slender, and well-muscled with short legs and a long, tapering tail.
Coat is short to medium-length, coarse, and grizzled in grey, brown, or reddish-brown with a lighter underside.

Head_and_Face: Head is broad with a pointed muzzle and dark patches around the eyes.
Ears are small, rounded, and set low.
Eyes are dark with distinctive dark patches surrounding them.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is small, slender, and well-muscled with short legs and a long, tapering tail.
Coat is short, coarse, and greyish-brown with dark bands across the back and a lighter underside.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail has a black or reddish tip.
Only four toes on each foot is a signature feature.
